svg.title: Clockpit wiring — Standard main switch
svg.desc: GP5: Mode; GP13: Up; GP9: Down. Buttons short to ground. GP22 drives matrix DIN directly. A main switch feeds 5 V to VSYS and the matrix. Disconnect the VSYS supply wire before connecting powered USB.
svg.text: Wiring diagram • Raspberry Pi Pico W / Pico 2 W
Top view • USB connector at the top
5 V RGB NeoPixel matrix • direct 3.3 V data • no external protection diode • GPIO assignments from main.py
Do not connect these buttons to +5 V.
Connect data to DIN, not DOUT.
Size the supply for the 256-LED matrix.
+5 V → S4 → VSYS (39) and matrix +5 V
Supply − → Pico GND (28) and matrix GND
All three button inputs use pull-ups and are active low.
GP labels are GPIO numbers; pad numbers are physical pins.
Disconnect the +5 V → VSYS wire before plugging in USB.
S4 OFF alone does not isolate the matrix from USB power.
Feed the matrix directly from the supply through S4.
Check S4 DC current rating against the matrix load.
Dot = junction. Crossing without a dot = no connection. Normal operation: USB disconnected.
